summary: ICON-EU run-start averages are admissible only as sign-normalized canonical IntervalMean values over consecutive published steps, with an exact per-interval quantization bound and fail-closed checks. They are never Instantaneous. calcpar-equivalent (FLEXPART PBL and deposition) use requires the point-value reconstruction oracle owned by #244.

fields.note: ASOB_S is net short-wave (downward minus reflected), not global radiation: the land-mean net/downward ratio is 0.84 and net never exceeds downward. The getvdep comment says global radiation, but its input is ECMWF net SSR, the same quantity. The within-bound clip is the readwind_ecmwf ssr clip (windfields_mod.f90:2367).

temporal.source_representation: PDT 4.8 average (statistical processing 0) over [run start, valid time], time unit minutes, zero at step 0
temporal.derivation: (t2*A(t2) - t1*A(t1)) / (t2 - t1) for consecutive published steps t1 < t2 of one cycle (DWD manual 7.1.1)
temporal.canonical_time: TemporalKind::IntervalMean with interval_start = cycle + t1 and interval_end = valid_time = cycle + t2
temporal.step_zero: never a canonical value: it has no interval, and its zeros would read as an absent flux (FLEXPART hflswitch/strswitch)

interval_lengths.cycles_00_06_12_18_utc: 1 h through 78 h, then 3 h to 120 h
interval_lengths.cycles_03_09_15_21_utc: 1 h through 30 h, then 6 h (36, 42, 48 h)

temporal.instantaneous: NOT_ADMISSIBLE: an interval mean is not a point value and is never relabelled (#120 unchanged; #74/#89 sampling stays unavailable)
temporal.calcpar_equivalent_use: REQUIRES_NEW_TEMPORAL_ORACLE: pinned FLEXPART reads flex_extract dapoly point values at memtime and applies nonlinear calcpar diagnostics (ustar from |stress|, Obukhov length). Applying dapoly to ICON means is structurally possible but unproven; #244 owns that decision and its pinned-routine oracle.

quantization.packing: CCSDS template 5.42, 16 bits; decoded value = (R + X*2^E) / 10^D with float32 reference R
quantization.interval_bound: (t2*e(t2) + t1*e(t1)) / (t2 - t1); grows linearly with lead time for a fixed interval length
quantization.rounding_evidence: night-time interior ASOB_S interval means fill [-bound, +bound] symmetrically (77-78 h: -0.3008 to +0.3008 W m-2 for a 0.3027 bound), as round-to-nearest predicts and floor packing would not
quantization.magnitude_cap_reason: The normative flex_extract de-accumulation of ECMWF forecast accumulations has the same lead-time amplification and no cap. A cap would be a new consumer-sensitivity tolerance outside #233.

fail_closed_rules: Reject any message whose octets are not the expected parameter, PDT 4.8, statistical processing 0, averaging start 0, one time range, minute units, range length = 60*step and interval end = valid time; file names are never evidence.
Derive means only between consecutive published steps of one cycle; reject missing steps, mixed cycles and duplicate message identities.
Never emit step 0 or any derived mean as Instantaneous.
Carry the per-interval quantization bound with each derived field; reject when the packing metadata needed for it is absent or not template 5.42/5.0.
ASOB_S: clip derived means in [-bound, 0) to 0; reject the field when any ingested cell is below -bound, or any night cell (sun below -1 deg for the whole interval) is outside +-bound.
ASHFL_S: negate after derivation; no other sign handling.

shortwave_consistency.finding: All violations lie in the three easternmost columns (62.375-62.5 E) at 68-70 N, up to 6.2x the bound. The cause is not established. Under the fail-closed rule, a domain that contains these cells rejects ASOB_S for the affected intervals; #244 decides their admission for point reconstruction.
shortwave_consistency.budget_finding: ASOB_S = ASWDIR_S + ASWDIFD_S - ASWDIFU_S within packing error in all but at most 0.74% of cells per sampled step. The residuals are almost always negative and concentrate over elevated land. This does not change the net-downward sign verdict.

open_items: Cause of the eastern-edge ASOB_S de-averaging inconsistency; it is undetectable for the other three fields, which have no physical bound.
Cause of the short-wave budget non-closure over elevated land (terrain radiation treatment is suspected, not established).
